Q → R (if the officer loves the college then the girl loses the paper)

R → P → Q, which means R → Q (if the girl loses the paper then the officer loves the college)

This is claiming the converse of what we can actually derive. Just because R → Q doesn't mean Q → R.

- If R is false, P is could be true or false
- If P is true, Q must be true (by premise 1)
- So Q could be true while R is false

This would make Q → R false.
